text:
emma_cs: FYI we just got a high-priority report from AcmeCorp — they say a bunch of prompts that used to return X now return Y after last night's model rollout. Customer is seeing incorrect facts and truncated reasoning in multi-step prompts.
liam_support: Customer sent examples and a minimal repro. They claim this started ~03:20 UTC after a 'performance profile' change. Attaching their sample: https://acme.example/repro.txt (private link).
emma_cs: Copied sample here: request payload uses model `redwood-v2-chat` with quant_profile `int8-p3-balanced` and model_version `v2026-03-16-23`. Before rollout they were on `fp8-legacy` and `v2026-03-12`.
ryan_eng: tagging @marta_ml @oliver_sre — can someone reproduce quickly? If this is quant-related we should snapshot the profile change.
marta_ml: I'll run the customer's prompt set against both profiles and run token-diff. Can you paste one failing prompt inline?
emma_cs: Sure — short one: "Summarize the steps to onboard a database migration with zero downtime, include rollback triggers." Customer expected a multi-paragraph plan; now model returns one-liners and misses rollback checks.
ryan_eng: Possible hypotheses: 1) INT8 profile introduced aggressive kernel fusion that changes tokenization alignment; 2) FP8->INT8 pruning impacted attention head dynamics; 3) a bug in softmax numerical range.
oliver_sre: Deploy bot shows a canary rollout at 03:10 UTC that swapped default quant profile for `redwood-v2-chat` to `int8-p3-balanced`. Logs: `deploy-bot: rollout complete, route weight 100% -> int8-p3-balanced`
deploy-bot: [system] canary -> main promotion: deploy_id=deploy-20260316-2310, changed_profile=int8-p3-balanced, previous_profile=fp8-legacy
marta_ml: I ran quick reproducer locally with the exact model_version and quant_profile. Results: fp8-legacy -> long structured plan (expected). int8-p3-balanced -> shorter output, missing 'automatic failover' and 'read-only switch' sections. Token-level difference shows missing tokens after token 42, often stopping at mid-sentence.
liam_support: Customer also attached API logs. They see many 502s around the same time, but majority were 200. They flagged quality degradation not latency.
ryan_eng: Can you paste the API request headers? Need to ensure content-length and streaming mode same.
liam_support: Headers snippet: \n```\nPOST /v1/chat/completions\nmodel: redwood-v2-chat\nquant_profile: int8-p3-balanced\ntemperature: 0.0\nmax_tokens: 512\nstream: false\n```\n
marta_ml: OK reproduction looks consistent. Two experiments: 1) run int8-p3-balanced with KV cache warm vs cold -> small difference. 2) run int8-p3-balanced with deterministic seeds vs stochastic -> still shorter. Hypothesis: quantization introduced reduced dynamic range in layernorm causing early termination in beam scoring.
ryan_eng: If layernorm/clamp changed, we should roll back profile for that model and confirm customer. Recommend emergency config rollback to fp8-legacy for `redwood-v2-chat` until we have a patch.
oliver_sre: Rolling back now — creating rollback job. Will route 100% traffic back to fp8-legacy for model redwood-v2-chat. ETA ~6 min.
deploy-bot: [system] rollback job started: rollback-20260317-0018, target_profile=fp8-legacy, affected_model=redwood-v2-chat
emma_cs: Let me tell AcmeCorp and ask them to re-run their test after rollback.
liam_support: Customer confirmed after rollback: their failing prompts now match previous outputs. They attached diffs. "This is blocking our release, thanks for quick action."
marta_ml: I'll run a deeper regression suite comparing 2000 prompt shards across fp8-legacy and int8-p3-balanced and post results to the incident ticket. Need to understand whether it's a deterministic degradation or only for certain prompt shapes.
ryan_eng: Action items: 1) Marta: run full eval and gather stats (perplexity, ROUGE on prompt set, token truncation counts). 2) Oliver: keep fp8-legacy as default while we investigate. 3) Liam/Emma: keep customer updated and capture additional examples. 4) Eng-runtime: bisect quant change to specific kernel or clamp change.
liam_support: Customer asked if this was a billing/quota issue — confirmed not billing. They only care about output fidelity.
marta_ml: Early numbers: int8-p3-balanced shows 3.7% increase in early-termination rate and 12% drop in ROUGE-L on the customer's validation prompts. I'll upload CSVs to the ticket.
ryan_eng: If we can reproduce in a unit test, we can create a guard to block promoting that profile until perf vs fidelity thresholds met.
oliver_sre: Keeping this thread open; I created incident https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20260317-004 for postmortem.
emma_cs: Thanks team — customer is relieved rollback worked. Please share postmortem and mitigation plan.
liam_support: Closing note from customer: "Appreciate quick turnaround. Please notify us before future profile defaults change." :pray:
